company.description: Waha Capital’s principal investment and co-investment interests span various sectors, including aircraft leasing, offshore oil and gas services, healthcare and financial services. The company also has a strong track record in capital markets, through its own proprietary credit portfolio as well as offering advisory services . In addition, Waha Capital is a co-sponsor of the MENA Infrastructure Fund, and is investing significantly in high quality light industrial real estate through the ALMARKAZ project in Abu Dhabi.
